message: Schema title collision detected: Multiple schemas use title 'Flower'. Schema 'Daisy' conflicts with schema 'Rose', and Fern names schemas after their titles (title-as-schema-name). Change one of the titles, or set 'resolve-schema-collisions: true' in generators.yml (and resolveSchemaCollisions: true on this rule) to resolve collisions automatically.
